title: A survey on measuring indirect discrimination in machine learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a survey of mathematical and statistical measures for indirect discrimination. It does not present a specific benchmark but notes that the surveyed measures can be applied to protected attributes like 'religion or belief'.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. It only identifies 'religion or belief' as a legally protected characteristic in the European Union, implying that the discrimination measures surveyed could be used to detect bias on this ground.
